common_name: Ellen Huston Dahlia (AGM Dwarf Bronze-Leaf Scarlet Dahlia)

planting.note: Plant tubers 4-6 inches deep after the last frost in full sun; Ellen Huston is a compact, Award of Garden Merit bedding dahlia grown for its dark bronze-purple foliage as much as its flowers.

directions: Ellen Huston is a dwarf bedding dahlia carrying small single scarlet flowers held just above dark bronze-purple foliage, giving the same dramatic leaf-and-bloom contrast as taller border dahlias like Bishop of Llandaff but on a compact, no-stake-needed plant. Its small stature and heavy, repeat-flowering habit make it well suited to the front of a border, mixed containers, or edging where taller dahlias would overwhelm the scale. Pinch out the growing tip while young to encourage bushy branching, and deadhead regularly through summer to keep new buds coming. Lift and store tubers after the first hard frost blackens the foliage in zones colder than 8.
